hostRules.description: Authenticate GitHub Packages RubyGems lookups. Without this, `bundle install` fails for any Gemfile with a private `rubygems.pkg.github.com` source, so Renovate cannot update Gemfile.lock and drops every gem PR.
Authenticate Docker Hub lookups to avoid the anonymous-pull rate limit (100 pulls/6hr per IP), which was causing intermittent 'no-result' lookup failures across many unrelated dependencies.

ECR Public is a public registry — explicitly clear all credentials so Renovate does not send Docker Hub auth to it. The org-wide docker rule above has no matchHost, so without this override it applies to public.ecr.aws and causes silent digest lookup failures.
